errors.evidence: The chart is divided into five slices, not six.

errors.text_span: a legend positioned to the left of the chart
errors.evidence: The legend is located in the center of the donut chart, not to the left.

errors.text_span: The slices are visually arranged in descending order of size.
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged in descending order of size. The order of percentages is 41.2%, 14.9%, 30.5%, 9.1%, and 4.3%.
The slice for "Moive" is colored light blue, not dark blue.

errors.text_span: the “Common” slice is colored light blue at 14.9%
errors.evidence: The "Common" slice is colored light green, not light blue.
The slice for "Person" represents 30.5% of the chart, not 14.9%.
The "Sport" slice is colored light purple, not light green.

errors.text_span: and finally “Topics” is colored purple and represents 30.5% of the chart
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain a slice labeled "Topics". "Topics" is the title of the legend. This part of the description hallucinates a slice and incorrectly assigns the value from the "Person" slice (30.5%) and the color from the "Sport" slice (purple) to it.
